Name: (FS) Zodiac Homestuck Troll Shirts
Author: aclumpofmoss413
Description:
So, I was really surprised to find no one had ever made any Homestuck-themed content packs for Fashion Sense. I mean, these kids might be getting killed (and paralysed. and blinded. and double death'd.) by the dozen, but damn if they aren't styling.

  This content pack adds twelve (twelve!) new shirts that cycle through the troll blood castes (or, in plebian terms, the "zodiac"), as well as my very own Extended Zodiac sign, [url=http://hs.hiveswap.com/ezodiac/truesign.php?TS=Canpio]Canpio[/url] (Sign of the Effervescent, Light + Prospit). If you like the zodiac but don't care about Homestuck, that's fine, feel free to get this too!

  If this mod ends up attracting attention, I could add more shirts from the EZ, or even try my hand at the kids or cherubs' symbols!

  This is my first ever mod, which I mostly made for myself, but I was encouraged by my friends to publish it, so feel free to drop a note or comment with suggestions or concrit, or just to tell me if you liked it!

Downloads.Description: initial release! this contains the following shirts: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, and Canpio.
